title: optseq2
description: Optseq2 is a tool for automatically scheduling events for rapid-presentation event-related (RPER) fMRI experiments.

ntp.description: Number of time points to be acquired during the scan.
ntp.title: Number of Time Points

tr.description: Temporal resolution of acquisition in seconds.
tr.title: Temporal Resolution

tprescan.description: Start events t seconds before first acquisition.
tprescan.title: Pre-scan Time

psdwin.description: Post-stimulus window specifications: minimum PSD, maximum PSD, and optional dPSD.
psdwin.title: PSD Window

event.description: Event type specification with label, duration, and number of repetitions.
event.title: Event

repvar.description: Allow number of repetitions of event types to vary by percentage, optionally per event.
repvar.title: Repetition Variation

polyfit.description: Add polynomial regressors as nuisance variables of specified order.
polyfit.title: Polynomial Fit Order

tnullmin.description: Minimum duration of null time between stimuli in seconds.
tnullmin.title: Minimum Null Duration

tnullmax.description: Maximum duration of null time between stimuli in seconds.
tnullmax.title: Maximum Null Duration

nsearch.description: Search over a specified number of iterations for schedules.
nsearch.title: Number of Searches

tsearch.description: Search for schedules over a specified number of hours.
tsearch.title: Search Time

ar1.description: Optimize assuming whitening with AR1 parameter
ar1.title: AR1 Parameter

penalize.description: Penalize for presentations being too close with parameters alpha, T, and dtmin.
penalize.title: Presentation Penalty

evc.description: Contrast of event types with weights.
evc.title: Event Contrast

cmtx.description: Load contrast from ASCII matrix file.
cmtx.title: Contrast Matrix

cost.description: Specify cost function and its parameters.
cost.title: Cost Function

sumdelays.description: Sum delays when forming contrast matrix.
sumdelays.title: Sum Delays

seed.description: Initialize random number generator with seed value.
seed.title: Random Seed

nkeep.description: Number of best schedules to keep.
nkeep.title: Number Keep

mtxstem.description: Output stem for saved design matrices.
mtxstem.title: Matrix Stem

pctupdate.description: Percentage interval after which progress is logged.
pctupdate.title: Percent Update

sviterfile.description: File to save information from each iteration.
sviterfile.title: Save Iteration Information

instem.description: Initialize with input schedules that match instem-RRR.par.
instem.title: Input Stem

nosearch.description: Do not perform search for optimal schedules.
nosearch.title: No Search Flag
